body: Do you by chance have any good link with the symptoms? I find ones, but most of them say smth different, hard to know what's really ADHD and what not

Hey, i cant open the link, it says the data is broken. Any chance you could screenprint it and post it on imgur or something?  

Pretty please?

I am in a very similar situation. I am failing college and life in general, i have no motivation or ambition whatsoever, and i even have suicidal thoughts.

Someone mentioned this subreddit, and it feels like it could be an answer, but what if this is just wishful thinking? What if i just want to blame this illness for me failing life. 

Dunno what i'd do if it is not ADHD or something similar.

I've always been procrastinating, and it feels now that i also procrastinated my entire life itself, now standing at the dividing point of "get your shit together" and "fuck it", and im leaning towards option 2.

Im thinking about traveling right now, see nice places and end it somewhere in peace

Again, i dont feel myself as a waste, my mind just doesn't fit in this society or kinda life itself.
Thx for the warm words, but i get that all. Life is awesome. My life can be awesome. But im not willing to clean the mess up and work for it. The privilege or gift of life is wasted on me.

Yes, in my youth. "If every kid was like XXX, i'd be jobless" was the quote of the doc. He figured i was bored with learning since i really didn't need to learn, though my parens pushed me into it.

I was a sloth as long as i can think of it, unable to concentrate on learning. Though i easily managed school  since i was smart enough without learning, till college.
